entries.title: Opus 5.5: 52.41 V2WScore, 33.6% task success
entries.summary: The refreshed 222-instance snapshot leads on task success, progress and build rate. Explore component metrics and five selected execution cases.
entries.cover_alt: Claude Opus 5.5 simulation: the robot arm lifts the red block off the table (pick-and-place, verified case).
entries.headline: Claude Opus 5.5 takes the lead
entries.dek: 33.6% task success, 11.3 points ahead of the next model, with the highest build rate in the snapshot.

entries.title: GPT-6.1 Sol: 41.19 V2WScore
entries.summary: 91.0% build rate and 10.9% task success in the published 222-instance snapshot. Inspect geometric fidelity and remaining execution gaps.
entries.headline: GPT-6.1 Sol makes a generational leap
entries.dek: Six times the task success of GPT-5.6 Sol, with builds nearly as reliable as the leader.
entries.cover_alt: GPT-6.1 Sol simulation: the robot inserts the desk leg (verified task success).

points.label: Up from GPT-5.6 Sol
points.text: V2WScore rises from 27.97 to 41.19 and task success from 1.8% to 10.9%. Stage progress climbs from 0.08 to 0.30.

points.label: Close to the leader on building
points.text: 91.0% of its worlds build, against 92.3% for Claude Opus 5.5. Object shape and size errors are on par with the leader.

points.label: The gap is in the last step
points.text: Task success is about a third of Claude Opus 5.5's, and the final object position is further off: 38.8 cm terminal translation error against 29.0 cm.

compare.title: From GPT-5.6 Sol to GPT-6.1 Sol

entries.title: Muse Wonder: 27.90 V2WScore
entries.summary: 86.7% build rate and 2.8% task success. The report examines executability, physical fidelity and diagnostic limits.
entries.headline: Meta Muse Wonder builds worlds that run
entries.dek: 86.7% of its worlds execute, yet 2.8% complete the task. Its first Video2World result shows where the gap opens.
entries.cover_alt: Meta Muse Wonder simulation: the robot arm picks up the block (verified task success).

points.label: Builds on par with the field
points.text: 86.7% of its worlds build, inside the 80–92% range of all twelve evaluated models.

points.label: Completion stays rare
points.text: Task success is 2.8% and stage progress 0.08. It ranks ninth, tied with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 27.90 V2WScore.

points.label: Where the gap opens
points.text: Scene error is 8.04 cm against 5.60 cm for the leader, and the final object position is 47.3 cm off against 29.0 cm.

funnel.title: From a running world to a finished task

campaign.title: Four flagship models. One benchmark.
campaign.description: A joint comparison of Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, Meta Muse Wonder and GPT-6.1 Sol, supported by model reports and verified executions.
campaign.release_rule: Publish the joint comparison after all four results are verified on a compatible protocol.
campaign.publication_note: Three model reports are available. Gemini 4 Argon remains in testing; the four-model comparison is in preparation. The methodology blog is a separate technical report.
